panels.title: Critical
panels.description: Critical CVEs, summed over all scanned images

panels.title: High
panels.description: High CVEs

panels.title: Medium
panels.description: Medium CVEs

panels.title: Images
panels.description: Images with CVEs: distinct image:tag combinations with at least one finding

panels.title: New
panels.description: New in 24h: CVEs (Medium and up) that were not there 24h ago: a new CVE in a known image or a newly deployed image. Shows n/a until there is 24h of history.

targets.expr: count(trivy_vulnerability_id{namespace=~"$namespace",severity=~"Critical|High|Medium"} unless trivy_vulnerability_id offset 1d) and on() (count(trivy_vulnerability_id offset 1d) > 0)

panels.title: Resolved
panels.description: Resolved in 24h: CVEs (Medium and up) that were there 24h ago and are gone now: image updated or workload removed. Shows n/a until there is 24h of history.

targets.expr: count(trivy_vulnerability_id{namespace=~"$namespace",severity=~"Critical|High|Medium"} offset 1d unless trivy_vulnerability_id) and on() (count(trivy_vulnerability_id offset 1d) > 0)

panels.title: Secrets
panels.description: Exposed secrets found inside images

panels.title: Scanned
panels.description: Scanned images: distinct image:tag combinations with an image report

panels.title: Posture per namespace
panels.description: One row per namespace: where the findings are. Config High+ and RBAC Medium+ count only the serious ones.

panels.title: Where to start: what to update
Images to update (worst first)
panels.description: One row per image, with the CVE count per severity. Updating one image clears all of its rows at once.

panels.title: Packages to upgrade (most CVEs fixed first)
panels.description: Per package: how many CVEs the upgrade to the fixed version resolves. Medium and up only.

targets.expr: count by (image_repository, image_tag, resource, installed_version, fixed_version) (trivy_vulnerability_id{namespace=~"$namespace",severity=~"Critical|High|Medium",vuln_id=~".*$cve.*"})

panels.title: Top CVEs (most workloads affected)
panels.description: Workload/container combinations per CVE. Use the CVE text box above to filter.

panels.title: Detail: CVE per workload and package (loads when opened)
CVE detail (workload, package, versions)
panels.description: One row per CVE per container. Package is the affected library or OS package.

panels.title: Workloads with High/Critical misconfiguration
panels.description: Privileged containers, host namespaces, dangerous capabilities and similar. Fix these before the Low findings.

panels.title: Detail: config audit check per resource (loads when opened)
Detail: RBAC check per role (loads when opened)
Secrets found inside images
panels.description: Often test or snakeoil keys shipped in the image; check the File column before acting.

panels.title: Images on the latest tag
panels.description: A moving tag makes a scan result hard to reproduce and an update invisible. Pin a version or digest.

targets.expr: count by (namespace, image_repository, image_tag, resource_kind, resource_name) (trivy_image_info{namespace=~"$namespace",image_tag=~"latest|"})
count by (namespace, image_repository, image_tag, image_os_family, image_os_name) (trivy_image_info{namespace=~"$namespace"})

panels.title: Operator
panels.description: Prometheus can scrape the operator (alert TrivyOperatorDown)

panels.title: Failed scan jobs
panels.description: Scan jobs in failed state right now

panels.title: Running scans
panels.description: Scan jobs running now (limit 1)

panels.title: Alerts
panels.description: Pending or firing Trivy alerts. TrivyCriticalFixableCVE stays pending for 7 days before it fires.

panels.title: Reports
panels.description: Image reports the operator holds right now
